name: finshield-git-agent
description: FinShield Git Automation MCP Server for automated test verification, merge conflict simulation, committing, pushing, and repository synchronization.

tools.name: git_auto_push
tools.description: Autonomous full-pipeline push: runs test suite verification, checks for merge conflicts, auto-generates conventional commit message if needed, stages, pulls cleanly, and pushes to GitHub.

verify.description: Run automated test suite verification before pushing

tools.name: git_check_conflicts
tools.description: Deep merge conflict inspection. Simulates remote merge in-memory, detects conflict markers, and verifies clean pushability without modifying workspace.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Get current git branch, staged files, unstaged changes, untracked files, conflicted files, and remote status in structured JSON.

tools.name: git_stage_all
tools.description: Stage all modified, deleted, and untracked files in the repository.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Stage all changes and create a conventional formatted commit.

type.description: Type e.g. feat, fix, chore, docs

tools.name: git_branch
tools.description: Create and checkout a new branch for feature isolation.

name.description: Branch name to create or switch to

tools.name: git_pull
tools.description: Pull latest changes from remote repository.
